name.en: Jobs, incidents and seniority for labour
name.ja: 労働に職種と出来事を足す

description.en: Labour at the administrative office becomes a list of jobs at the town's own facilities: pay follows your ability scores and how long you have worked for that employer, incidents ask for a choice between terms, and town events change the pay or ask for hands. Illegal labour at the underworld office pays 2x to 4x by danger, with crackdowns, retaliation and betrayal that your ability scores make less likely
description.ja: 役場の労働が、その街の施設の仕事の一覧になる（3件が月ごとに入れ替わる）。賃金は能力値と雇い主ごとの勤続で変わり、働く合間に出来事が起きて選択肢で応じる。街の出来事で賃金が変わり、困り事には臨時の募集が出る。裏の事務所の闇労働は危険度に応じて賃金が 2〜4 倍になり、取り締まり・仕返し・裏切りが起きる（能力値が高いほど起きにくい）

note.en: Length up to age 29. The game's own value is 90 (3 months). With the age rule on, it grows by a third every 5 years from 30 (pay does not). Pay scales with this length
